draft.title: Sustainable management
card: Sustainable management means using resources to meet the needs of people today without harming the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
the wellbeing of people, such as health, jobs, fair access to resources and the value of culture and community.
the money a resource earns and the jobs and income it supports, now and in the future.
the health of land, water, air and living things, and whether they can recover from the way a resource is used.
draft.remember: Sustainable management meets today's needs and protects the future by balancing social, economic and environmental goals.

a.q: Which choice best describes sustainable management of a forest?
opts: Harvesting timber at a rate the forest can regrow
Harvesting all timber now to earn the most profit
Banning all access so that no one can use the forest
Harvesting timber until the forest stops regrowing
a.why: Sustainable management meets present needs while leaving the resource able to support future generations. Harvesting at a rate the forest can regrow does both. Taking all the timber now earns the most money, but it ignores future generations.
a.clue: Which choice still leaves the forest able to support people later?

b.q: A council in a coastal town allows a new marina. It will create jobs, but it will damage a seagrass bed that fish use. Which change would best balance the three goals?
opts: Build a smaller marina and protect the seagrass bed
Build the full marina, as jobs matter most to the town
Cancel the marina, as the seagrass bed matters most
Build the full marina and plant seagrass elsewhere later
b.why: A smaller marina keeps some jobs and income while protecting the environment, so it balances the goals. Building the full marina puts the economic goal first and risks harm that may not be undone. Cancelling it protects the seagrass but gives up the economic and social gains.
b.clue: Look for the choice that keeps something for all three goals.

a.best: Harvesting timber at a rate the forest can regrow

b.best: Build a smaller marina and protect the seagrass bed
